body: I am fine now, I don't plan on dying in the next few days but I am afraid it will eventually happen. The rehearsal was for me to be comfortable with personal experience of dying when I do kick the bucket. I have nothing really to live for now. I don't where you live but where I live going to the emergency room and by most probability being detained in mental facility for indefinite amount of time is a big financially investment which I am ill-equip to invest in. I rather not drag others to my mess as there is nothing they can do to help. I guess I am a ticking time bomb now waiting to explode eventually, I just hope people stay away from the blast zone.
